map.资本利得税 T = 100000 × 0.10 = 10,000 元；利得翻倍到: Capital gains tax T = 100000 x 0.10 = 10,000 CNY; if gain doubles to 200k, tax is 20k.
map.若利得为 −30000（亏损），多数规则下税额取 max(0, 利得×r)=0，: If the gain is -30000 (loss), most rules take tax = max(0, gain x r) = 0, and the loss can be carried forward to offset future gains.
map.资本利得税与所得税有何区别？: How does capital gains tax differ from income tax?
map.资本利得税专门对资产增值（买卖差价）征收，通常税率或免税规则与工薪所得税不同。: Capital gains tax is levied specifically on asset appreciation (buy-sell spread); its rate or exemption usually differs from wage income tax.
map.亏损一般当年不缴税，并可在规定年限内结转，抵减今后实现的利得。: Losses generally incur no tax that year and can be carried forward within the allowed years to offset future realized gains.
